name: Stereochemistry and Physical Organic Chemistry
description:
14. Course contents
Stereochemistry/Stereoisomerism, Types of chirality, Isomerism about single bonds in acyclic systems- Torsional isomerism, rotation about a C-heteroatom and heteroatom-heteroatom bond, Inversion of N atom, Chirality in heteroatoms, Conformations in cyclic systems ( 4-8 membered rings, with or without heteroatom), Bicyclic systems, Reaction Intermediates, Substitution and elimination reactions, Stereoselective approach to E1, E2, E1cb reaction mechanisms. Methods of Determining Reaction Mechanisms: Introduction to kinetic vs thermodynamic processes. Primary kinetic isotopic effect, Crossover experiment, Curtin-Hammett principle, Hammonds postulate, Hammett Equation, Linear Free Energy Relationship (LFER).
